summary.value: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel is a big, practical 51-story hotel located near Times Square that guests rate for clean rooms, warm front-desk staff and a walkable location. Some find rooms only average, and parking is very expensive.

description.value: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel is a 51-story hotel located near Times Square on Seventh Avenue, a convention-scale property with many room types for groups. Trip.com guests rate it 7.8 / 10 Good 158 reviews and report Room is great and clean, plus front-desk staff who go out of their way. Honest watch-outs: room quality is described as so-so by some, parking costs a lot, and one guest adds I expected a sauna/Spa as it is listed under amenities.

itineraryNote: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel: a 51-story hotel located near Times Square with friendly staff; walk to Broadway, Rockefeller Center and Central Park.
review1: Guests find Sheraton Times Square's rooms clean and generally pleasant, which makes it a dependable base for a busy Midtown itinerary.
review2: Front desk staff draw warm praise for friendliness and occasional extras, which leaves guests with a good impression from arrival onward.
review3: The walkable location is a recurring plus, with Times Square, the theater district and Central Park all reachable on foot.
review4: Watch-outs center on rooms that some guests describe as only average and on very expensive parking, so plan transit rather than a car.
